five focused tests (tests/gpu_plan.rs), render-gpu-consumer example, rustfmt

Auto = one platform-preferred backend per instance (DX12 then Vulkan on Windows), real device-loss + reacquire proof on the parity device, HSK_STUDIO_TEST_GPU_BACKEND test selector, probe backend argument

capabilities_done: GpuContext::acquire/acquire_next: headless instance+adapter+device (no surface, no window, no focus), validation layers off, bounded block_on, generation counter (1, +1 per reacquire), device-lost callback + uncaptured-error latch (no wgpu panic path)

GpuBackend (Ready|Lost|Unavailable under one Mutex): new() never fails; reacquire(cancel) is the only recovery (generation+1, residency cleared, failed reacquire keeps the loss); with_injected_loss (doc(hidden) fault injection); simulate_device_loss (real device.destroy path)
Residency: pure-Rust LRU with pins, hard budget, exact used/peak/evictions, hit/touch, mark/release_since (release on every exit); every device buffer is charged BEFORE it is created
WGSL kernel.wgsl: one compute pass per layer (solid or uploaded region), straight-alpha source-over + Normal/Multiply/Screen = pigment blend_math::composite_over in f32

plan_sink: pigment admit() first, source verification (hash/stride/shape/domain) before the device state check, chunk loop (chunk shrinks from 512 to fit min(request.max_working_bytes, residency budget, device buffer limit); < 64 texels -> BudgetExceeded), clear + per-layer dispatch + staging read-back into TileSink, cancel/deadline between chunks and layers, receipt only after last chunk

exactness table: tile/solid exact, blend normal/multiply/screen fitted, fill_opacity approximate (product), everything else unsupported and refused at admission (other modes, masks, nested/pass-through groups, vector, premultiplied)
report(): one Observe terminal frame, same outcome mapping as render-cpu; DESCRIPTOR; example render-gpu-consumer --descriptor | --probe [backend] | --selftest

decisions_for_lead: Exactness for blend operators is Fitted (per diagnostics/render-plan-ir.md); an export request with min_exactness Exact therefore refuses the GPU backend by design (preview/accelerated path, CPU stays the reference).
Observe outcome mapping reuses render-cpu's (BudgetExceeded -> Validation) rather than the brief's (BudgetExceeded -> Unsupported) so one BackendError has one terminal outcome on every backend.

Brief test 1 says a missing adapter must FAIL the GPU test; lead's dispatch says skip-with-typed-Unavailable is acceptable only for the GPU-execution test. Implemented the dispatch: the GPU test passes without an adapter only after asserting the typed Unavailable and printing NOT_PROVEN. The validator host needs an adapter (this one has an RTX 3090) for a GPU PASS.
Residency has no cross-call tile cache in slice 1 (ResidentKey::Tile is reserved for it); every allocation is per-call and released, so 'used returns to the pre-call value' holds exactly.
Auto backend order is a product decision I made for latency: Windows DX12 then Vulkan, Apple Metal, otherwise Vulkan. Vulkan/Dx12/Metal remain selectable.
